design_principles: Codebook v1.1 supersedes v1. Only codebook_v1.json and the three specified critic reports were read; human-annotator feedback supplied in the request was incorporated. No files were modified and no web sources were used.
All factor and domain display labels use English. Multilingual cues are annotation aids, not verified quotations or sufficient keyword rules.

Factors identify text-supported product complaints, including explicitly attributed evaluations and allegations. They do not establish engineering causes, internal priorities, malicious intent, or historical facts.
Owner teams are proposed accountable routing roles, not verified organizational assignments. Routing an allegation does not endorse it.

Preserve universal -> family -> game relationships where substantive distinctions justify them. Families describe reusable mechanisms and may cross genres. Related sandbox world/character-state mechanisms share a family identifier but retain distinct universal parents.

Annotate original-language evidence spans and complaint propositions. Store the most specific eligible factor as primary; derive ancestors only for roll-up. Never count an ancestor and its descendant as independent complaints.

Core means ready for annotation calibration, not a validated classifier. Candidate factors remain in calibration and diagnostic records until validated. Watchlist leaves remain non-production hypotheses. Production coding uses a supported core ancestor; if none exists, retain an unresolved record rather than forcing another factor.

When one proposition explicitly supports multiple non-ancestor factors, preserve linked annotations using one proposition ID. Separate propositions require separately identifiable evidence. Review prevalence counts each review once per factor; proposition totals must deduplicate linked annotations.

The v1 provenance reports 3,244 records across 31 syntheses before deduplication. approx_support remains a single-code discovery anchor, not a deduplicated count, sum, prevalence estimate, or confidence score. Narrowed definitions require recoding; inherited anchors are not recalculated memberships.

Omit approx_support when no numerical anchor is available. The owner's 80-review exercise is a sampling denominator, not the number of update-regression complaints. Critic-supplied examples and counts are secondary provenance, not independently inspected reviews.

Add service.update_regression for explicit complaints that an update, patch, or version transition worsened the experience. An affected subsystem need not be identified. Mere update timing is metadata; explicit deterioration is a complaint factor.

Update regression is distinct from content availability, maintenance claims, and communication. A patch removing a valued feature may support linked regression and content annotations. Do not infer neglect, bad communication, or a verified causal mechanism.

Technical coding follows operability and referent: slow or intermittently stalled execution that resumes is performance; failure to launch, termination, or inability to continue until recovery/restart is stability; a named feature or state transition failing is functionality. Duration alone does not resolve an ambiguous freeze.

Generic bugs must not duplicate a named crash or freeze in the same proposition. Explicit compatibility evidence takes precedence over a bare launch symptom for that proposition. Do not infer an intentional platform prohibition from incompatibility.

Working but implausible simulated behavior uses gameplay.ai_simulation. Discrete malfunction uses tech.functionality. If unclear, explicit bug/failure wording may support functionality; otherwise preserve ambiguity.
Human pairing disparity, human-match scarcity, and chosen-group participation barriers are separate. A bot-filled match does not automatically establish an additional skill-matching complaint.
Cheating requires an explicit unauthorized-advantage or failed-enforcement allegation. Permitted aim assistance uses input balance. Unqualified auto-aim wording remains unresolved.

Bare boring gameplay is affect and unresolved aspect evaluation. gameplay.core_loop requires an identifiable action, interaction, or cadence referent. Do not infer onboarding failure, completion, or player incompetence.
Paid randomness requires textual evidence of both payment and uncertain acquisition. Spending without obtaining an item does not establish a random mechanism through outside game knowledge.

Maintenance factors record the reviewer's explicit stewardship claim. Reported update/fix history is stored separately from inferred priorities or abandonment; neither is independently verified by annotation.

Participant absence or noncooperation does not establish intent. Administrative abuse, participant misconduct, specific disputed sanctions, public communication, and individual case handling have separate boundaries.
Steam recommendation, textual polarity, attribution, affect, harm, stated behavior, and observed behavior remain separate. Positive or descriptive aspect mentions do not activate complaint factors.
Jerry's seed judgments remain design checks, not immutable ground truth. Revise seed labels when the final rules require it; preserve uncertainty where original seed text is unavailable.

Keep source stratum, discovery code, merged aliases, example IDs, evidence availability, and migration decisions. Crosswalk targets are conditional alternatives; compound codes require span-level recoding and never transfer their full counts to every destination.

Validate with independent double coding, adjudication, per-language positive agreement, sibling-confusion analysis, and held-out games/time periods. Cluster duplicate templates and reviewer histories across splits. Promote factors using independently worded evidence and operational usefulness.

Keep future behavior outside factor annotation and classifier inputs. Prespecify follow-up windows, censoring, representative sampling, and weighting. Continued play does not establish low harm; associations do not establish causal effects.
All critic issues are addressed. Where competing recommendations required a different implementation, the decision and reason are recorded in open_questions.

domains.label: Technical quality
domains.description: Execution, persistent state, online continuity, synchronization, and compatibility.

domains.label: Gameplay systems
domains.description: Interaction, challenge, balance, agency, randomness, and simulated behavior.

domains.label: Progression and investment
domains.description: Advancement, rewards, effort, intended losses, and maintenance burdens.

domains.label: Content and presentation
domains.description: Content availability, narrative, spatial design, audiovisual expression, and creative identity.

domains.label: Multiplayer and integrity
domains.description: Fair competition, participant availability, cooperation, conduct, sanctions, and administrative authority.

domains.label: Usability and accessibility
domains.description: Operating, understanding, perceiving, and localizing the experience.

domains.label: Commerce and access
domains.description: Purchases, selling practices, ownership, access requirements, and account/device protection.

domains.label: Release and service
domains.description: Release readiness, update deterioration, stewardship claims, representations, communication, and customer remedies.

factors.label: Performance and loading
factors.definition: Local execution is slow, uneven, or excessively resource-intensive while remaining operable or resuming without recovery.
include_rules: Low FPS, stutter, excessive loading, shader delays, identified local input latency, or resource burden.
Temporary freezes explicitly described as resuming; a stated duration alone does not determine the factor.
exclude_rules: Failure requiring recovery/restart: tech.stability. Named feature failure: tech.functionality.
Explicit online delay: tech.network.responsiveness. Bare lag or ambiguous freezing remains unresolved.
Do not duplicate generic bug wording for the same symptom.

factors.label: Launch and crash failures
factors.definition: Execution fails to start, terminates, or becomes unusable until recovery or restart.
include_rules: Crashes, launch errors, installation failures preventing execution, persistent black screens, or hangs that prevent continuing.
Bare failure to launch without explicit compatibility or access-policy evidence.
exclude_rules: Temporary slowdowns that resume: tech.performance. A named quest or feature failing: tech.functionality.
Explicit platform integration failure uses tech.platform_compatibility for the same proposition.
Service outages and objections to mandatory access rules have separate factors; generic bugs do not duplicate a named crash.
multilingual_cues: zh: 闪退、启动不了、卡死要重启

factors.label: Broken functions
factors.definition: A feature, interaction, state transition, or feedback function malfunctions.
include_rules: Quest blockers, collision glitches, missing combat sounds, unrecorded rewards, or discrete AI malfunctions.
Explicit nonspecific bug/failure claims only when they are not a restatement of a more specific technical symptom.
exclude_rules: Working but implausible simulated behavior: gameplay.ai_simulation.
Crashes, performance, persistence, and input-device failures use their specific factors.
Unclear defect-versus-design wording without an explicit failure claim remains unresolved.
multilingual_cues: zh: 任务触发不了、穿模

factors.label: Save and data loss
factors.definition: State that should persist is technically lost, corrupted, overwritten, or inaccessible.
include_rules: Broken saving/loading, cloud overwrites, character/world corruption, or technical inventory rollback.
exclude_rules: Designed resets, death penalties, checkpoint limits, account theft, and entitlement policy restrictions.

factors.label: Network delay and desync
factors.definition: Online state arrives late or inconsistently during an established session.
include_rules: Ping, packet loss, rubber-banding, desync, tick-rate complaints, or explicitly network-attributed hit registration.
exclude_rules: Connection loss, local FPS problems, and missed hits without networking evidence.

factors.label: Connection failures
factors.definition: Technical service failure prevents joining, maintaining, or rejoining an online session.
include_rules: Outages, disconnects, failed room joining, reconnect failures, or service-wide authentication failures.
exclude_rules: Functioning queues, insufficient players, account-specific recovery, sanctions, and intentional restrictions.

factors.label: Compatibility failures
factors.definition: Explicit incompatibility or integration failure involving a named operating system, runtime, platform, mod, or distribution interface obstructs use.
include_rules: Reported Linux/Proton or other OS/runtime incompatibility, broken Workshop integration, mod incompatibility, or platform interoperability failure.
Record whether official support is stated, denied, or unknown; do not infer it.
exclude_rules: Explicit mandatory launcher/account/online rules or platform prohibitions: business.access_requirements.
Bare failure to launch without integration evidence: tech.stability.
Patch size, download burden, or disliked update frequency alone is not compatibility failure.

factors.label: Interaction and play rhythm
factors.definition: An identified recurring action, interaction, or cadence is criticized as repetitive, awkward, unsatisfying, or slow.
include_rules: Repeated fetch actions, disliked combat or movement interaction, long recovery animations, or forced action downtime.
Clunky combat identifies an interaction referent and defaults here unless device/input or difficulty evidence supports a different factor.
exclude_rules: Bare boring gameplay, solo boredom, or not fun without an action/interaction/cadence referent: affect and unresolved aspect evaluation.
Content quantity, input mapping/device problems, spatial layout, and difficulty without interaction criticism.
multilingual_cues: en: repetitive fetch tasks, clunky combat
zh: 反复跑腿、战斗手感别扭

factors.label: Balance and counterplay
factors.definition: Working rules give options, roles, equipment, or sides disproportionate power or inadequate counterplay.
include_rules: Overpowered weapons/heroes, weak roles, map-side advantage, permitted input disparities, or imported equipment power imbalance.
exclude_rules: Human skill matching, unauthorized tools, and difficulty alone. Paid power uses business.paid_advantage without automatic duplication.

factors.label: Difficulty and encounter fairness
factors.definition: Stated execution demands, hazards, enemy pressure, or difficulty curves fail the desired challenge experience.
include_rules: Too hard/easy, difficulty spikes, unreadable attacks, unfair enemy pressure, or poor solo scaling.
exclude_rules: Do not infer incompetence or difficulty from clunky combat. Pairing disparities, guidance gaps, input operation, and retry cost are separate.

factors.label: AI and simulation quality
factors.definition: An identifiable working behavior of computer-controlled actors or modeled systems is criticized as inept or implausible.
include_rules: Irrational decisions, ineffective companion behavior, unrealistic traffic, vehicle physics, wildlife, or working crime-response rules.
exclude_rules: Discrete malfunction: tech.functionality. Unwanted bots replacing humans: social.match_availability.
Unclear broken-AI wording uses functionality only for an explicit failure claim; otherwise retain defect_vs_design uncertainty.
A supported game leaf is primary; this ancestor is derived.
multilingual_cues: zh: AI决策很蠢、物理不真实

factors.label: Meaningful choices
factors.definition: Available mechanical decisions offer insufficient depth, freedom, or meaningful influence.
include_rules: Shallow builds, mandatory solutions, restrictive customization/construction, or inconsequential strategic decisions.
exclude_rules: Narrative consequences, explicit randomness, simple power imbalance, and content quantity alone.
multilingual_cues: en: no build freedom, choices meaningless

factors.label: Nonpaid randomness
factors.definition: Nonpaid chance is perceived as biased, excessively decisive, or obstructive.
include_rules: Rigged draws/dice allegations, random build viability, unwanted drop variance, or chance-dominated combat.
exclude_rules: Paid acquisition chances and grind without explicit randomness. Alleged rigging is not verified fact.
multilingual_cues: zh: 全靠运气、概率被操控

factors.label: Effort, rewards, and loss
factors.definition: Required effort, advancement, rewards, or retained investment feel disproportionate.
include_rules: Grind, weak rewards, time gates, intended resets, death losses, retry costs, or maintenance burdens.
exclude_rules: Technical loss, unrecorded rewards, and payment mechanisms without an independent effort/reward complaint.
multilingual_cues: zh: 太肝、奖励少、损失太重

factors.label: Content breadth and availability
factors.definition: Activities, modes, features, or authored material lack breadth, variety, or availability.
include_rules: Short campaigns, repetitive mission templates, missing/removed modes, insufficient endgame, or restricted map availability.
A promised feature supports this factor when the proposition explicitly criticizes its absence; link to service.marketing_trust if the same proposition also asserts misrepresentation.
exclude_rules: Story quality, repetitive actions alone, defective functions, or copying/series identity alone.
Update regression requires an explicit worsening transition; content absence alone does not establish it.
A promise breach without an independent availability harm uses service.marketing_trust.

factors.label: Story and characters
factors.definition: Writing, characters, themes, endings, or story consequences fail expectations.
include_rules: Weak plot, flat characters, incoherent endings, rejected in-game themes, or inconsequential dialogue choices.
exclude_rules: Voice performance, missing skip controls, and external political/company protests.

factors.label: World and level design
factors.definition: Spatial layout or environmental interactivity makes exploration and encounter flow unsatisfying.
include_rules: Empty worlds, poor routes, needless traversal, inaccessible environments, or poor encounter placement.
exclude_rules: Unclear instructions, map count alone, and competitive side-power complaints without a spatial-design proposition.
multilingual_cues: zh: 世界空洞、地图设计差
ru: пустой мир, плохой дизайн карты

factors.label: Audiovisuals and atmosphere
factors.definition: Visual/audio expression fails aesthetically or fails to produce the intended atmosphere.
include_rules: Unappealing graphics, skins, animation, music, voice performance, or atmosphere.
exclude_rules: Broken assets/audio, perceptual barriers, physical discomfort, and cosmetic prices.

factors.label: Originality and series identity
factors.definition: The reviewer explicitly objects to perceived copying or departure from an established series, remake, or genre identity.
include_rules: Alleged derivative design, a remake failing to preserve the original identity, or a sequel abandoning defining series/genre characteristics.
exclude_rules: A competitor name, generic inferior sequel judgment, personal genre dislike, missing content, or boring gameplay without identity/copying evidence.
multilingual_cues: en: a copy, lost the series identity
zh: 抄袭换皮、失去系列特色、重制没原味

factors.label: Cheating and failed enforcement
factors.definition: An explicit allegation of unauthorized advantage or failed integrity enforcement compromises legitimate play.
include_rules: Alleged cheats, prohibited software/scripts/converters, illicit collusion, exploit abuse, or ineffective cheat prevention/reporting.
exclude_rules: Permitted aim assist and mixed-input balance: fam.competitive_shooter.input_balance.
Auto-aim without a permitted-input or unauthorized-tool referent remains unresolved.
Ordinary smurf disparities, disputed bans, and invasive anti-cheat deployment use other factors.
multilingual_cues: en: aimbot cheat, anti-cheat does nothing
zh: 外挂、违规转换器、举报外挂没用

factors.label: Skill and team matching
factors.definition: Human player assignment creates inappropriate skill, experience, headcount, or premade-team disparities.
include_rules: Novices versus veterans, smurf stomping, rank tanking, solos versus premades, or explicitly unequal human-team composition.
exclude_rules: Missing humans due to stated scarcity or bot substitution: social.match_availability.
Rules preventing a chosen group from playing together: social.cooperation.
An unexplained missing teammate does not establish pairing disparity. Co-code scarcity and disparity only when separate clauses establish both.
multilingual_cues: zh: 炸鱼、匹配不公、单排打车队

factors.label: Human-match availability
factors.definition: Players cannot obtain timely participation in the expected human multiplayer population.
include_rules: Long functioning queues, empty servers, population fragmentation, explicitly unfilled population demand, or unwanted bots replacing humans.
exclude_rules: Technical joining failures, AI competence, pairing disparity alone, and inferred developer responsibility for low population.
multilingual_cues: zh: 鬼服、排不到人、全是人机

factors.label: Group play and coordination
factors.definition: Participation rules or missing tools obstruct playing and coordinating with a chosen group.
include_rules: Party limits, host dependence, missing communication tools, friend-group dependence, or shared-progression restrictions.
exclude_rules: Teammate misconduct, technical joining defects, payment gates, population scarcity, assigned-team disparities, and solo difficulty alone.
multilingual_cues: en: host only, no party tools
zh: 只有房主能操作、组队受限

factors.label: Disruptive player conduct
factors.definition: Reported participant behavior disrupts play or creates hostility, with inadequate protection where stated.
include_rules: Harassment, reported griefing, team-killing, exclusion, AFK, abandonment, observed noncooperation, or failed behavior moderation.
exclude_rules: Do not infer deliberate intent from absence or noncooperation; explicit intent allegations belong in attribution metadata.
Cheats, structural coordination barriers, own disputed sanctions, and abuse of administrative authority use separate factors.
multilingual_cues: zh: 喷人、队伤、挂机秒退、不配合

factors.label: Disputed punishments
factors.definition: A particular ban, kick, cooldown, or enforcement procedure is alleged to be unjustified, disproportionate, or opaque.
include_rules: Alleged false bans, abusive kicks, disproportionate penalties, missing rationale, or denied appeal rights.
Disputed punishment triggered by a reported crash/disconnect; annotate the technical event separately only when independently evidenced.
exclude_rules: Criticism of handling a submitted appeal: service.support; use both only for distinct spans.
Ordinary designed ranked participation costs or forced spectating: fam.ranked_competitive.rating.
Broader administrative abuse without a specific contested penalty: social.governance.
Authentication errors without punishment and account theft.
multilingual_cues: zh: 误封、乱封、掉线被罚
evidence_strata: game_cs:false_vac_ban=22; mixed authentication/sanctions, not allocated wholesale

factors.label: Administrative abuse
factors.definition: A server host, GM, moderator, or official community operator is alleged to exercise authority arbitrarily, discriminatorily, or abusively.
include_rules: Admin favoritism, coercive rule enforcement, misuse of privileged powers, retaliatory censorship, or exclusion through administrative action.
exclude_rules: A recipient's specific disputed ban/kick alone: social.sanctions.
Hostile statements, unclear notices, or ignored public feedback without an exercise-of-power complaint: service.communication.
Ordinary player misconduct: social.conduct. Broader abuse and a particular sanction require distinct propositions.
multilingual_cues: zh: 管理员滥权、GM偏袒、删帖打压

factors.label: Interface and workflow
factors.definition: Menus, information organization, or interaction steps make routine operation difficult.
include_rules: Confusing menus, inventory friction, excessive steps, or missing skip/playback controls.
exclude_rules: Missing rules knowledge, input mapping, commercial intrusion alone, and intentional inventory-economy limits.
multilingual_cues: zh: 界面复杂、不能跳过

factors.label: Controls and input devices
factors.definition: An identified device, mapping, camera, input-feedback, or action-execution problem obstructs intended player actions.
include_rules: Missing rebinding, broken controller/wheel/HOTAS support, unusable mappings, camera-control obstruction, or explicitly poor controller operation.
exclude_rules: Bare clunky combat or intended movement weight: gameplay.core_loop. Stated difficulty: gameplay.challenge. Competitive assistance: input balance. Latency alone: technical factors.
multilingual_cues: zh: 不能改键、手柄不能用
ru: нельзя переназначить, геймпад не работает

factors.label: Guidance and goals
factors.definition: Players lack understandable guidance about rules, actions, goals, or progression.
include_rules: Missing tutorials, obscure prerequisites, unclear objectives, contradictory instructions, or required external guides.
exclude_rules: Understood difficulty, technical tutorial blockers, and cumbersome but comprehensible UI.
multilingual_cues: en: no tutorial, need a wiki
zh: 不知道干什么、必须查攻略

factors.label: Language and localization
factors.definition: Unavailable, inaccurate, incomplete, or unusable language support obstructs use.
include_rules: Missing translations, poor localization, script/font problems, or language-switch friction.
exclude_rules: Story criticism independent of translation, teammate language mismatch, and voice acting quality alone.

factors.label: Perception and comfort
factors.definition: Presentation or missing accommodations impede comfortable perception or physical use.
include_rules: Unreadable text, obscured enemies, motion sickness, inaccessible contrast, or missing relevant display options.
exclude_rules: Aesthetic dislike, technically missing sounds, and difficulty without an access barrier.

factors.label: Price and value
factors.definition: Monetary cost or pricing treatment is explicitly criticized relative to value or affordability.
include_rules: Overpriced games/cosmetics/DLC, regional affordability, discount unfairness, purchase devaluation, or explicitly excessive spending for the received value.
exclude_rules: A monetary amount, payment, missing item, or refund intent alone. Do not infer paid randomness from high spending.

factors.label: Paid power and boosts
factors.definition: Spending buys gameplay strength or progression acceleration relative to nonpayment.
include_rules: Pay-to-win equipment, premium economic advantages, or purchasable grind bypasses.
exclude_rules: Cosmetics without power, access-only purchases, and grind without purchasable relief.
multilingual_cues: en: pay to win, buy power
zh: 氪金变强、付费碾压

factors.label: Paid access barriers
factors.definition: Payment boundaries restrict desired functionality, content, or participation.
include_rules: Core features sold separately, subscription gates, paid hosting, or locked playable content.
exclude_rules: Price alone, failed delivery of an owned entitlement, and optional external workarounds that do not gate native access.
multilingual_cues: zh: 付费门槛、本体拆卖

factors.label: Paid random rewards
factors.definition: The text identifies payment for uncertain acquisition and criticizes its odds, duplicates, or acquisition burden.
include_rules: Paid gacha, purchased random packs/boxes, paid draws, or explicitly uncertain rewards bought with money or purchased currency.
exclude_rules: Payment and uncertainty must both be text-supported; packs/boxes alone do not establish payment or randomness in every context.
Spent a large amount but did not receive an heirloom does not alone establish paid chance.
Free drops, direct sales, and nonrandom passes. Unspecified commercial mechanisms remain unresolved.
multilingual_cues: en: paid random packs, purchase odds
zh: 氪金抽卡、付费开箱概率
evidence_strata: game_apex:costly_random_cosmetic_acquisition=1; insufficient mechanism evidence flagged by overlap critic

factors.label: Intrusive selling
factors.definition: Promotions, advertisements, or selling practices intrude on participation or pressure spending.
include_rules: Store pop-ups, ads in paid games, criticized offer frequency, or purchase FOMO.
exclude_rules: High prices, ugly skins, skins-over-fixes claims, and bare greed/cash-grab insults without an identifiable selling practice.
multilingual_cues: zh: 商城弹窗、广告太多、限时逼氪

factors.label: Access requirements
factors.definition: Explicitly stated dependencies or access policies constrain use of the product.
include_rules: Mandatory launcher/account, always-online rule, regional block, explicitly prohibited platform, required external service, or forced product replacement.
exclude_rules: Do not infer deliberate prohibition from Linux/Proton incompatibility or a failure to launch. Technical failures, sanctions, payment gates, and owned-item transfer restrictions have separate factors.
multilingual_cues: zh: 强制启动器、必须联网、锁区

factors.label: Ownership and delivery
factors.definition: Players cannot receive, retain, transfer, or use goods or benefits they regard as owned.
include_rules: Undelivered paid items, revoked DLC, item trade limits, or account/platform entitlement-transfer restrictions.
exclude_rules: Technical save corruption, new purchase gates, and launcher failure without entitlement evidence.
multilingual_cues: en: paid items missing, cannot trade
zh: 买了没到账、不能交易
ru: купленное не выдали, нельзя передать

factors.label: Account security and recovery
factors.definition: Account-specific compromise, authentication, or recovery prevents control of an account.
include_rules: Theft, phishing, recovery failures, or account-specific verification barriers.
exclude_rules: Service-wide login outages, dislike of account requirements, sanctions, and device/privacy objections.

factors.label: Privacy and device security
factors.definition: Software or service practices allegedly expose personal data or devices to unwanted risk.
include_rules: Intrusive telemetry, kernel anti-cheat objections, alleged malware/mining, or device vulnerabilities.
exclude_rules: Account recovery, weak cheat detection, and anti-cheat FPS costs without a security/privacy proposition.
multilingual_cues: zh: 隐私泄露、挖矿、反作弊侵入系统

factors.label: Perceived maintenance neglect
factors.definition: The reviewer explicitly criticizes maintenance cadence, repeated non-remediation, abandonment, or perceived development priorities.
include_rules: Explicit claims that longstanding defects remain unfixed, updates are inadequate, the game is abandoned, or cosmetics are prioritized over repairs.
Store inferred priorities/abandonment as attributed claims and cited update/fix history in reported_maintenance_history.
exclude_rules: A current defect, low population, or an update regression alone does not establish neglect.
Individual tickets, public statements, release incompleteness, and misrepresentation have separate factors.
Never treat the factor as verified resource allocation or maintenance causation.
multilingual_cues: en: abandoned, skins instead of fixes
zh: 一直不修、只顾卖皮肤

factors.label: Misleading product claims
factors.definition: A concrete product representation, disclosure, or review practice is alleged to mislead customers.
include_rules: Broken advertised promises, misleading requirements/editions, late material disclosures, or alleged review manipulation.
If one span explicitly asserts both a broken promise and unavailable content, link this annotation with content.scope_variety under one proposition ID.
exclude_rules: Unstated expectations, missing features alone, generic unfinished judgments, vague scam insults, and unrelated corporate protests.
multilingual_cues: zh: 虚假宣传、画饼、刷好评

factors.label: Official communication
factors.definition: Official public statements, notices, responses, or feedback handling are absent, unclear, or dismissive.
include_rules: Unclear maintenance notices, ignored public feedback, absent explanations, or hostile official statements without an administrative-action complaint.
exclude_rules: Retaliatory censorship or other abuse of authority: social.governance.
Individual tickets: service.support. Defects or updates alone do not establish communication failure.
Player abuse, failed cheat enforcement alone, and unrelated company conduct.
multilingual_cues: en: no notice, ignores public feedback
zh: 没公告、无视反馈、官方回应敷衍
evidence_strata: family_vehicle_combat_sim:criticism_censorship=5; former anchor transferred to governance where supported

factors.label: Support and remedies
factors.definition: Seeking individual assistance or remedy encounters ineffective, inaccessible, or obstructive case handling.
include_rules: Ignored submitted tickets/appeals, template responses, unresolved purchase cases, or refund-process barriers.
exclude_rules: Sanction validity, proportionality, rationale, or the right to appeal: social.sanctions.
Apply support and sanctions together only for distinct evidence spans.
Refund desire alone and public developer silence.
multilingual_cues: zh: 客服不处理、申诉没人回、退款受阻

factors.label: Unfinished release
factors.definition: The product is alleged to have been released or sold in a materially incomplete or insufficiently polished state.
include_rules: Explicit sold unfinished, launched half-baked, or not ready for release judgments.
Criticism that a paid early-access offering is materially unready; early-access status alone is not a complaint.
exclude_rules: A discrete defect alone: technical factors. A missing advertised feature alone: service.marketing_trust.
Subsequent abandonment: service.maintenance. A worse update: service.update_regression.
Unfinished without a release/sale-state referent remains unresolved. Add concrete defects or deception only when separately stated.
multilingual_cues: en: sold unfinished, not ready to launch
zh: 半成品就卖、没做完就上线

factors.label: Updates made it worse
factors.definition: The reviewer explicitly attributes a worse experience to an update, patch, redesign, or version transition relative to an earlier state.
include_rules: The patch ruined the game, each update makes it worse, or the previous version was better in an explicit update/version comparison.
New or worsened defects after a patch, unwanted redesigns, or changed/removed features that make the updated experience worse.
The update-level deterioration claim is sufficient even when the affected mechanism is unspecified.
When a concrete symptom or content loss is also stated, retain the specific factor and link shared evidence under one proposition ID.
exclude_rules: A review date, patch mention, or current defect without an asserted worsening transition.
Missing content without an update/worsening claim: content.scope_variety.
Sparse updates, repeated non-remediation, or perceived priorities without deterioration: service.maintenance.
Missing announcements or poor public responses: service.communication.
Initial-release incompleteness, neutral changes, successor comparisons without a version-transition complaint, or patch download burden alone.
multilingual_cues: en: patch made it worse, unwanted redesign
zh: 越更新越差、更新改废了、旧版更好
ru: обновление испортило игру, раньше было лучше
evidence_strata: user human-annotator feedback: repeatedly needed during 80 random negative reviews; complaint count unavailable
v1 discovery lineage: patch_regression; updates_regress_quality; patches_cause_regressions; updates_perceived_to_regress_quality; patch_volatility_hinders_learning; counts unavailable
overlap critic: rid 14032391 reports update-associated bugs/crashes; original review not inspected

factors.label: Battle-royale loot fairness
factors.definition: Random or uneven in-match equipment distribution makes survival excessively dependent on loot opportunity.
include_rules: Unviable landing loot, gear lottery, or unfair resource distribution.
exclude_rules: Paid loot boxes, weapon strength independent of availability, and ordinary progression drops.
multilingual_cues: zh: 落地没枪、搜物资靠脸

factors.label: Battle-royale encounter flow
factors.definition: Dropping, looting, rotating, fighting, and elimination create unsatisfying encounter timing.
include_rules: Long downtime followed by abrupt elimination, repeated third-party pressure, or explicitly criticized zone-driven flow.
exclude_rules: Generic bad maps, connection delays, loot quality alone, and inferred zone complaints.
multilingual_cues: en: loot then die, constant third parties
zh: 搜半天秒死、一直被劝架
ru: долго лутаешься и сразу умираешь

factors.label: Input-method balance
factors.definition: Permitted input assistance or mixed-input competition creates unequal competitive capabilities.
include_rules: Controller-versus-mouse assistance explicitly discussed as a built-in/allowed input rule, or mixed-input pools with stated advantage.
exclude_rules: Alleged prohibited converters/scripts: social.cheating. Bare auto-aim without a clear input-rule or prohibited-tool referent remains unresolved. Broken device support uses ux.controls.
multilingual_cues: zh: 手柄内置辅瞄太强

factors.label: Hero and role balance
factors.definition: Hero/class power or role interactions undermine viable compositions and participation.
include_rules: Overpowered heroes, useless roles, or explicit composition counterplay failures.
exclude_rules: Teammate skill, missing teammates, paid hero locks, and cooperation tools.
multilingual_cues: zh: 英雄超模、职业没用

factors.label: Ranked rules and incentives
factors.definition: Rank scoring, qualification, resets, or designed participation costs impose unwanted effort or reward achievement poorly.
include_rules: Unfair rank gains/losses, disliked scoring incentives, repeated calibration, or ordinary post-death exit rules requiring unwanted spectating.
exclude_rules: Opponent strength, technically unrecorded points, and reward absence without rank-rule evidence.
A particular erroneous, opaque, or disproportionate enforcement action, including punishment after technical failure: social.sanctions.
multilingual_cues: en: unfair rank points, forced spectating
zh: 排位积分不合理、死后还得观战
ru: несправедливые рейтинговые очки, обязуют наблюдать

factors.label: Narrative choice effects
factors.definition: Backgrounds, dialogue, or role choices produce insufficient narrative differences.
include_rules: Illusory story branches or inconsequential role/background choices.
exclude_rules: Mechanical build depth and plot quality without choice evidence.

factors.label: RPG build depth
factors.definition: Character advancement offers shallow, constrained, or poorly differentiated builds.
include_rules: Inconsequential perks, restricted respec/loadouts, or forced build paths.
exclude_rules: Narrative choices, grind alone, and a strong option without a build-freedom complaint.

factors.label: Open-world interaction
factors.definition: An explorable world lacks meaningful accessible interactions relative to its apparent scale.
include_rules: Decorative-only spaces, inaccessible environments, or lifeless exploration.
exclude_rules: AI behavior alone, total content length, and simple route inconvenience.

factors.label: Sandbox building freedom
factors.definition: Construction capabilities constrain desired creations independently of settlement population rules.
include_rules: Restrictive object-building eligibility, unavailable blueprint transfer, or limited construction customization.
exclude_rules: NPC housing/settlement eligibility: fam.sandbox.settlement_rules. Tool usability, unclear requirements, resource grind, and technical placement defects.
multilingual_cues: zh: 建造功能受限、蓝图不能转移
evidence_strata: game_terraria:restrictive_npc_town_rules=3; transferred to settlement_rules, not current support

factors.label: Cross-world transfer balance
factors.definition: Rules allowing character, inventory, or equipment state to cross worlds/sessions create an explicit power or progression imbalance.
include_rules: Imported advanced equipment overpowering a fresh shared world or persistent characters bypassing its intended power constraints.
exclude_rules: Save corruption, entitlement transfer restrictions, ordinary veteran skill, and prohibited item generation. Transfer alone is not imbalance.
multilingual_cues: en: imported endgame gear breaks balance
zh: 跨世界带装备破坏平衡

factors.label: World-state upkeep burden
factors.definition: Designed environmental state changes threaten retained building investment or impose unwanted recurring upkeep.
include_rules: Spreading environmental hazards that require containment or repeatedly threaten player-built areas.
exclude_rules: Save corruption, generic resource grind, combat difficulty, and one-time destruction without an environmental-maintenance referent.
multilingual_cues: en: spreading hazard keeps ruining builds
zh: 环境蔓延毁家、反复清理太累
ru: распространение угроз требует постоянного ухода

factors.label: Settlement rule constraints
factors.definition: Designed housing, population, happiness, or settlement-eligibility rules restrict desired layouts or resident arrangements.
include_rules: Unwanted NPC separation, housing eligibility, or settlement service requirements constraining a chosen layout.
exclude_rules: Unclear rules alone: ux.onboarding. Generic construction capability: fam.sandbox.building_freedom. Malfunctioning eligibility: tech.functionality.
multilingual_cues: en: housing rules force unwanted layouts
zh: 住房规则限制布局、居民必须分开

factors.label: Boss encounter difficulty
factors.definition: Boss attacks, readability, health, or difficulty fail to provide satisfying challenge.
include_rules: Unfair patterns, excessive boss health/damage, or trivial bosses.
exclude_rules: Resummoning/runback cost alone and technical boss blockers.

factors.label: Checkpoint and retry cost
factors.definition: Designed retry requirements impose excessive repetition, travel, or resource cost.
include_rules: Long runbacks, sparse checkpoints, restrictive manual saving, or tedious boss resummoning.
exclude_rules: Technical save failures, boss difficulty alone, and permanent account loss.
multilingual_cues: zh: 跑尸太远、存档点太少

factors.label: Draw and pool fairness
factors.definition: Draws, deals, dice, or rotating unit pools allegedly overwhelm strategic agency or favor outcomes unfairly.
include_rules: Rigged hands, biased dice, or unavailable needed units in random shops.
exclude_rules: Paid acquisition, rule-resolution bugs, and imbalance independent of randomness.
multilingual_cues: zh: 发牌被操控、刷不到棋子

factors.label: Horror fear and tension
factors.definition: The authored experience fails to evoke expected fear, suspense, or sustained tension.
include_rules: Unscary horror, predictable scares, or mechanics explicitly undermining atmosphere.
exclude_rules: Resource balance or difficulty alone and generic dislike of horror.
multilingual_cues: zh: 不恐怖、没有紧张感

factors.label: Free accounts blamed for cheating
factors.definition: The reviewer explicitly attributes recurring CS cheating to free access or cheap replacement accounts.
include_rules: A stated free-access/cheap-replacement-to-cheating link; retain its attribution span.
exclude_rules: General cheating, purchase devaluation, Prime price, and external workaround payment alone. The claim is not causal evidence.
multilingual_cues: en: free accounts let cheaters return
ru: после бесплатного перехода больше читеров

factors.label: Forced CS:GO replacement
factors.definition: Replacement by CS2 removes access to the preferred CS:GO product.
include_rules: Objection to compulsory replacement or inability to retain the former product.
exclude_rules: Missing maps alone and generic sequel dislike. Add linked service.update_regression only for an explicit worsening transition, not compulsion alone.

factors.label: CS per-map calibration
factors.definition: Separate map-specific qualification creates unwanted repeated rank-calibration effort.
include_rules: Explicit repeated qualification across maps; retain as a diagnostic hypothesis.
exclude_rules: Generic rank grind and unfair opponents. Production uses fam.ranked_competitive.rating.

factors.label: Apex ranked incentives
factors.definition: Apex scoring rewards unwanted strategies or misrepresents achievement.
include_rules: Explicit ranked scoring, incentive, or scoring-redesign criticism.
exclude_rules: Hard lobbies, missing rewards without scoring evidence, and point-recording bugs. Explicit update deterioration may receive a linked regression annotation.
multilingual_cues: en: ranked rewards the wrong play
zh: 排位机制鼓励苟分
ru: рейтинговая система поощряет не то

factors.label: Apex third-party pressure
factors.definition: Encounter convergence repeatedly brings additional squads into ongoing fights.
include_rules: Excessive third parties attributed to map or fight flow.
exclude_rules: Ordinary multi-team combat without complaint and generic map quality.

factors.label: Cyberpunk quest blockers
factors.definition: A mission interaction or scripted state transition fails and blocks progression.
include_rules: Broken objectives, triggers, quest interactions, or scripted tutorials.
exclude_rules: Unclear directions, story dislike, slow advancement, and runtime freezes without a quest-state failure.
multilingual_cues: ru: квест не проходится из-за бага

factors.label: Cyberpunk lifepath effects
factors.definition: Lifepaths, backgrounds, or dialogue choices provide insufficient consequential differentiation.
include_rules: Explicit lifepath or branching-role consequence complaints.
exclude_rules: Generic poor writing and mechanical perk depth.

factors.label: Night City interaction
factors.definition: Night City's apparent density exceeds its accessible, meaningful world interactions.
include_rules: Decorative city spaces or unavailable everyday interactions.
exclude_rules: Police behavior alone and general performance or story complaints.
multilingual_cues: en: Night City is a facade

factors.label: Cyberpunk police response
factors.definition: Working crime-response, police-spawn, or pursuit behavior is criticized as implausible or systemically shallow.
include_rules: Arbitrary police appearance or implausible pursuit explicitly criticized as simulated behavior.
exclude_rules: Discrete malfunction uses tech.functionality; unrelated NPC behavior uses gameplay.ai_simulation.
During calibration store this leaf as primary and derive its ancestor. Production uses gameplay.ai_simulation until promotion.

factors.label: PUBG accelerator requirement
factors.definition: Usable access allegedly requires a designated external network accelerator.
include_rules: Explicit imposed accelerator dependency or blocked alternatives.
exclude_rules: Voluntary latency workarounds, generic high ping, and inferred exclusivity.
evidence_strata: game_pubg:forced_network_accelerator=25; repeated Chinese verse makes support template-sensitive

factors.label: PUBG map-choice limits
factors.definition: Selection or rotation rules prevent access to desired PUBG maps or modes.
include_rules: Removed map choice, unwanted forced rotation, or inaccessible preferred playlists.
exclude_rules: Map layout, queue failures, and assumed ranked context. Explicit update worsening may receive a linked regression annotation.

factors.label: PUBG post-death exit rules
factors.definition: Designed ranked participation rules impose a cost for leaving after death or require unwanted spectating.
include_rules: Explicit post-death leave-rule or forced-spectating criticism in ranked play; retain as a diagnostic hypothesis.
exclude_rules: A specific allegedly erroneous or opaque enforcement action: social.sanctions.
Technical disconnect punishment, general elimination pacing, and inferred ranked loot tables.
Production uses fam.ranked_competitive.rating.
multilingual_cues: en: watch after death or lose rank
zh: 死了退出还扣分、必须观战
ru: штраф за выход после смерти

factors.label: Terraria boss difficulty
factors.definition: A Terraria boss presents an unsatisfying or disproportionate challenge.
include_rules: Explicit boss attack, tuning, or difficulty complaints; diagnostic only.
exclude_rules: Resummoning cost alone. Production uses gameplay.challenge while the family remains candidate.

factors.label: Terraria imported gear imbalance
factors.definition: Imported equipped characters or endgame items bypass a shared world's intended power progression.
include_rules: Explicit imported-gear imbalance in multiplayer; diagnostic only.
exclude_rules: Cheating without prohibited-behavior evidence, data corruption, and veteran skill alone. Production uses gameplay.balance while the family remains candidate.
multilingual_cues: en: bring endgame gear from another world
zh: 跨世界带毕业装备
ru: приносят мощные вещи из другого мира

factors.label: Terraria settlement limits
factors.definition: NPC happiness or pylon eligibility constrains desired settlement layouts.
include_rules: Unwanted housing separation or layout requirements; diagnostic only.
exclude_rules: Unclear pylon rules alone: ux.onboarding. Production uses gameplay.agency while the family remains candidate.
multilingual_cues: zh: 幸福度限制城镇布局

factors.label: Terraria biome upkeep
factors.definition: Hostile biome spread threatens building investment or imposes unwanted recurring maintenance.
include_rules: Unwanted corruption/crimson spread threatening player-built areas; diagnostic only.
exclude_rules: Save-file corruption, ordinary combat difficulty, and biome names without complaint. Production uses progression.effort_reward while the family remains candidate.

review_level_fields.name: steam_recommendation
review_level_fields.definition: Platform recommendation flag, independent of textual polarity and factor presence.

review_level_fields.name: content_polarity
review_level_fields.definition: Overall semantic polarity after interpreting sarcasm and context.

review_level_fields.name: factor_mentions
review_level_fields.definition: Repeated records of factor_id when identifiable, original span, aspect/entity, valence, interpretation, coder, confidence, and proposition ID. An unspecified aspect mention need not receive a factor_id. Only supported negative propositions activate eligible complaint factors.

review_level_fields.name: attributability
review_level_fields.definition: Span-level attribution; several values may occur in one review. No player-blame residual.

review_level_fields.name: target_scope
review_level_fields.definition: Object of criticism. External protests do not automatically enter game-factor prevalence.

review_level_fields.name: unresolved_complaint
review_level_fields.definition: Preserve the original span and candidate interpretations. Explicit update-level worsening uses service.update_regression even if the affected subsystem is unknown. Unfinished release-state claims use service.release_readiness; unfinished with no release referent remains unresolved.

review_level_fields.name: reported_behavior
review_level_fields.definition: Self-reported actions and intentions, distinct from observed behavior.

review_level_fields.name: reported_affect_and_consequence
review_level_fields.definition: Explicit personal experiences; do not infer a psychiatric diagnosis or defective mechanism. Bare gameplay boredom belongs here.

review_level_fields.name: experienced_harm
review_level_fields.definition: Explicit consequences without automatic numerical severity or causal verification.

review_level_fields.name: claim_status
review_level_fields.definition: Attach to propositions. Claimed cheating, wrongful sanctions, copying, administrative abuse, motives, stewardship priorities, and update causation remain attributed claims.

review_level_fields.name: experience_context
review_level_fields.definition: Multi-valued context. Store game, mode, map, boss, hero, platform, hardware, input, region, and playtime as typed entities.

review_level_fields.name: mechanism_facets
review_level_fields.definition: Preserves queue/population/bot facets, enforcement/reporting facets, sanction types, trigger details, and named systems without multiplying factors.

review_level_fields.name: commercial_mechanism
review_level_fields.definition: Commercial object independent of dissatisfaction. A pass is not inherently random; spending without an item does not establish paid chance.

review_level_fields.name: change_context
review_level_fields.definition: Temporal/comparative context. Retain alongside service.update_regression when worsening is explicit; this field no longer substitutes for that complaint factor. Other change events do not automatically activate regression.

review_level_fields.name: version_attribution
review_level_fields.definition: Store creation/edit dates, claimed play date, build/era, and uncertainty. A review timestamp alone does not verify exposure.

review_level_fields.name: language_and_expression
review_level_fields.definition: Actual language codes plus expression flags; contextual annotation is required.

review_level_fields.name: coding_confidence
review_level_fields.definition: Per-proposition confidence with rationale. Keep model probabilities separate and calibrate thresholds.

review_level_fields.name: source_provenance
review_level_fields.definition: Store source file/stratum, code, aliases, example IDs, evidence-span availability, mapping action, and codebook version. Distinguish supplied summaries from inspected original reviews.

review_level_fields.name: duplicate_and_sampling_metadata
review_level_fields.definition: Store review/reviewer identifiers, sampling frame, inclusion probabilities if known, cluster ID, and cohort. Example IDs do not establish complete memberships.

review_level_fields.name: observed_play_30d
review_level_fields.definition: Proposed behavioral endpoint; finalize the window before analysis. Retain timestamps and distinguish follow-up play from activity near day 30. Omit when no observation data were supplied.

review_level_fields.name: observed_play_90d
review_level_fields.definition: Analogous day-90 endpoint. Missing visibility is not quitting; no observed play is not necessarily permanent churn. Omit when no observation data were supplied.

review_level_fields.name: analysis_eligibility
review_level_fields.definition: Separate complaint, scope, calibration, and behavior denominators. Retain excluded records for audits.

review_level_fields.name: proposition_linkage
review_level_fields.definition: Store proposition ID, span IDs, primary factor IDs, derived ancestors, and linked proposition IDs. Shared promise/absence or update/symptom annotations count once in proposition totals; derived ancestors are never new complaints.

review_level_fields.name: reported_maintenance_history
review_level_fields.definition: Store the reviewer's stated dates, versions, duration, recurrence, and history spans. These are reported observations, not verified history; keep them separate from priority or abandonment inferences.

review_level_fields.name: attribution_metadata
review_level_fields.definition: Record the claimed actor, causal/intent relation, and exact attribution span. Never infer intent from AFK or infer causal validation from a factor label.

review_level_fields.name: diagnostic_factor_ids
review_level_fields.definition: Store supported candidate/watchlist IDs separately from production primary factors. Use the nearest supported core ancestor in production, or unresolved_complaint=candidate_only_no_core_ancestor when none exists.

review_level_fields.name: platform_support_claim
review_level_fields.definition: Records what the review says about official platform support. Named incompatibility does not prove official support, deliberate exclusion, or policy intent.

mapping_from_codex19.reason: Organizing domain, not an annotation target.
Distinguish execution, named function failure, persistence, and explicit integration failure. Apply operability and same-proposition rules.
Preserve local execution performance; ambiguous lag/freezing remains unresolved.
Select from online delay, connection failure, population, pairing, explicit access rules, and account-specific barriers.
Workflow, input operation, perception, and language require distinct evidence.
Retain guidance; separate understood difficulty and technical tutorial failures.
Separate difficulty, power, chance, pairing, and retry/investment cost.
Require an identifiable action/system referent. Bare boring gameplay remains an unresolved evaluation and affect field.
Working-rule inequality, prohibited advantage, pairing, and contested enforcement are distinct.
Retain advancement and investment; payment and technical recording failures use their own factors.
Separate breadth, writing, space, expression, and explicit originality/identity complaints; identity is calibration-only until validated.
Distinguish chosen-group tools/rules, behavior, population, pairing, specific penalties, and broader authority abuse. Governance remains candidate.
Choose the stated commercial or seller-readiness complaint. Sold-unfinished claims now have an explicit destination; missing features alone do not prove deception or release unfitness.
Consequences and future behavior do not substitute for product complaint factors.
Equipment opportunity, encounter timing, and layout differ; no standalone zone factor is justified.

Restore reusable state-transfer, environmental-maintenance, and settlement-rule families under the shared sandbox_world_character_state family identifier. Their parents preserve balance, investment, and agency distinctions. Technical loss, construction capabilities, and entitlement rights retain separate destinations. Sparse Terraria leaves are diagnostic descendants, not default migration targets.
Retain quest-state blockers; derive tech.functionality instead of separately coding it.
Select actual power, choice, chosen-group barriers, human-team assignment, missing-human population, or paid-access evidence. Missing teammates alone do not establish every destination.

Designed ranked exit costs now descend from ranked rules/incentives. The PUBG leaf is watchlist-only; production uses its family. Maps, loot, and balance require their own evidence. Specific erroneous enforcement is separately recoded to social.sanctions.

jerry_cards_coding.note: Preserve frame-rate, server-lag, and explicitly attributed free-account cheating complaints. Derive social.cheating. ESEA does not establish native pay-to-win, Prime failure, or a native payment gate.

jerry_cards_coding.note: Repeated reset to level 3 supports failed persistence. Cloud overwrite, corruption, and account-sharing explanations remain hypotheses. No duplicate generic-bug label.

jerry_cards_coding.fields: content_polarity=negative; attributability=specific_product_issue; experience_context entities=story,combat,cutscene_skip; behavioral endpoints omitted.
jerry_cards_coding.note: The v1 summary identifies story criticism, an explicit combat-interaction referent, and missing skip controls. Retain those three factors without inferring input-device failure, difficulty, or franchise decline. If original wording lacks the summarized combat referent, recode that portion as unresolved affect.

jerry_cards_coding.fields: content_polarity=negative; attributability=uninformative_rant; reported_affect_and_consequence=anger; reported_behavior=none_stated; behavioral endpoints omitted.
jerry_cards_coding.note: Profanity supplies no identifiable product mechanism and does not establish quitting.

jerry_cards_coding.fields: content_polarity=negative; attributability=specific_product_issue,broad_unresolved_product_issue; reported_behavior=stopped_playing_reported; reported_affect_and_consequence=boredom; unresolved_complaint=aspect_evaluation_without_referent for solo boredom; experience_context=solo,public_match; diagnostic_factor_ids=watchlist(game.terraria.cross_world_gear),candidate(fam.sandbox.state_transfer); behavioral endpoints omitted.
jerry_cards_coding.note: Imported equipment imbalance supports the core ancestor. The Terraria leaf and reusable transfer family remain diagnostic. Remove gameplay.core_loop for bare solo boredom; no repeated action or cadence is established by the v1 summary. Do not infer onboarding failure, completion, cheating, or observed abandonment.
Enjoyment and regretted productivity loss coexist. No defective engagement mechanism or clinical condition is established.

jerry_cards_coding.fields: content_polarity=neutral; factor_mentions=positive(content.scope_variety,progression.effort_reward),uncertain(ux.interface); coding_confidence=adjudication_required for UI valence; behavioral endpoints omitted.
jerry_cards_coding.note: Preserve the experience-sharing interpretation. Comparative complexity activates ux.interface only if the text establishes an unwanted usability problem.
Positive preferences do not become complaint factors because the Steam recommendation is negative.

jerry_cards_coding.fields: content_polarity=negative; attributability=specific_product_issue; language_and_expression=zh,sarcasm; claim_status=allegation_or_inference; behavioral endpoints omitted.
jerry_cards_coding.note: The source expression meaning "support" is sarcastic, and the expression meaning "legitimate players" refers to players who do not cheat. Failed anti-cheat enforcement is included; no independent official-communication complaint is established.

jerry_cards_coding.fields: content_polarity=negative; attributability=specific_product_issue; language_and_expression=zh; experience_context=solo,ranked,new_player; entities=Diamond,controller,mouse,XIM,Cronus,skins,heirlooms; claim_status includes allegation_or_inference; attribution_metadata=developer_priority_claim; reported_maintenance_history=no_history_cited in the available summary; behavioral endpoints omitted.
jerry_cards_coding.note: Retain separate illicit-converter allegations and permitted aim-assist criticism only where their respective spans establish those referents. Bare auto-aim would remain unresolved. Preserve unfair matching, absent rewards, attributed skins-over-fixes priorities, ugly cosmetics, and recycled content. Do not infer paid randomness, high prices, update regression, or ranked scoring rules.
